top_band: thatched conical roof dome in yellow-brown shades from row 0 to row 57 (or 48 above the doorway)
evidence: The structure shows a large conical thatched roof (rows 0-58, around 49 rows above the central doorway) overhanging a mud-brick cylindrical front wall (rows 59-77). There is a clear eave shadow (rows 59-61) cast by the thatch overhang onto the wall, and a deeply recessed doorway.

style.evidence: The thatched roof has 6 distinct value steps with tiered vertical straw texture and cast shadows between layers. The mud wall below shows subtle brick/cobble variations, cylindrical form shading (light left, mid center, dark right), and a stone base. Outlines are dark brown tones matching the materials.
